tools.name: upload_gcode
tools.description: Upload G-code content or a local G-code file path to the printer. With print=true the exact uploaded bytes are inspected first (every S/R heater target, tool changes, hardware and material ceilings) and printer state is checked before the print starts.

gcode.description: G-code content, or a local path to a G-code file.

gcode_path.description: Local path to a G-code file to upload.

print.description: Start printing after upload when the printer backend supports it. Printing requires a declared material from slicer metadata (; filament_type = PLA) or the material argument.

material.description: Declared filament material (for example PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, PA, PC) when the G-code has no slicer filament_type metadata. Must not contradict the file. Material ceilings limit nozzle targets.

tools.name: start_print
tools.description: Start printing a G-code file already stored on the printer. The server downloads and inspects the exact file, then starts a uniquely named checked copy after printer-state checks. Printers whose API cannot download files (Repetier, Prusa, Creality) refuse; use upload_gcode with print=true instead.

tools.name: camera_stream_start
tools.description: Start or renew one persistent camera connection for this printer. Call only while watched; it closes automatically after idle_timeout_ms without a viewer request. camera_snapshot then reuses its latest frame. No printer motion or print commands.

port.description: Printer API port; defaults to PRINTER_PORT.

host.description: Printer host or IP; defaults to PRINTER_HOST.

bambu_token.description: Printer LAN access code; defaults to the configured access code.

fps.description: Maximum processed frames per second. The first viewer sets the rate until the stream closes.

idle_timeout_ms.description: Close the shared connection after this many milliseconds without a viewer request.

tools.name: camera_frame
tools.description: Read the shared camera stream, optionally waiting up to 10 seconds. Returns JPEG only when newer than since_seq and visibly changed (32×18 grayscale difference). Retain the last delivered frame's seq on unchanged. max_width resizes JPEG to the viewer. Does not start a stopped stream.

port.description: Printer API port; defaults to PRINTER_PORT.

api_key.description: Printer API key; defaults to API_KEY.

host.description: Printer host or IP; defaults to PRINTER_HOST.

bambu_serial.description: Printer serial number; defaults to the configured serial and identifies its shared stream.

bambu_token.description: Printer LAN access code; defaults to the configured access code.

since_seq.description: Sequence of the last delivered JPEG; retain it when a result is unchanged.

wait_ms.description: Maximum time to await a newer changed frame; zero returns immediately.

max_width.description: Optional maximum JPEG width in pixels, preserving aspect ratio and never enlarging.

max_bytes.description: Optional maximum encoded JPEG bytes. Downscales further at quality 70 when needed; base64 adds about one third plus protocol overhead. Use 42000 for a two-second 30 KB/s viewer budget.

changed_only.description: Return JPEG only when its thumbnail differs enough from the last delivered frame.

min_change.description: Minimum mean absolute grayscale thumbnail difference, normalized from zero to one.

tools.name: camera_stream_stop
tools.description: Close this printer's camera connection and free its cached frames. Other printers keep their own streams. Active viewers may restart it; normally let the idle timeout close a shared stream.

tools.name: counterpart_print_route
tools.description: Counterpart contract (counterpart/1), Bambu: how this server reaches the printer for prints and for Stop/Pause/Resume. route is "lan" (the local network through FULU's BambuNetwork bridge), "cloud" (Bambu Cloud through FULU's bridge) or "developer" (the local network straight to a printer in LAN Only + Developer Mode, whose Pause, Resume and Stop need no Bambu app). options lists each with its label, whether it can be chosen here (and why not) and what controls do on it; choices lists the ids that can be chosen. mode and type are BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_MODE and BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_TYPE as resolved. Pass route to change it: the change applies to the next print and control at once, and is saved to the .env file in this server's working directory when that file exists (savedTo; null otherwise). Sends nothing to the printer.

route.description: Change the route. Omit to read it.

tools.name: counterpart_printer_info
tools.description: Describe this printer for the counterpart/1 contract: server name and version, printer kind and identity, and which features work (progress, layers, camera, filaments, pause, resume, cancel, print_3mf, G-code), detected from the firmware. Read-only.

tools.name: get_printer_filaments
tools.description: Report the loaded filament. Bambu: the live AMS and external-spool inventory over MQTT, as bambu-printer-mcp reports it (trays with absolute slot, loaded state, material, colour, tray_info_idx and resolved slicer profile path; summary; recommended load_filaments), plus counterpart/1 slots for every loaded tray and external spool (254, and 255 on dual-nozzle printers). Other printers: one external slot (id "ext"); Moonraker printers with Spoolman report the active spool's material, colour and name, others source "unknown". Read-only.

tools.name: resume_print
tools.description: Resume a paused print. Resume reheats and moves the printer, so it only resumes a job this server instance inspected and started, and only when the printer freshly reports that job paused. Bambu re-reads the job over FTPS (or the plate G-code the printer extracted) and compares its SHA-256, and resumes over the same connection that printed. When the file cannot be re-read, a person confirms through MCP elicitation first (Bambu: only for files Bambu's plug-in placed; a file this server uploaded must re-read). Resume other jobs at the printer.

tools.name: slice_stl
tools.description: Slice an STL or 3MF file to generate G-code or a sliced 3MF. For Bambu-compatible CLI slicing (bambustudio, orcaslicer-bambulab, or orcaslicer with bambu_model), the exact bambu_model/nozzle machine preset from the selected slicer installation is required, profile inheritance is resolved before the CLI runs, and the result must contain plate G-code. Failures stop with the slicer's exit status and output. A 3MF that carries its own process settings (a designer's Bambu Studio or Orca project) slices with them unless slicer_profile, template_name or template_3mf_path is given; the machine still comes from bambu_model. quality and strength adjust that process, and strength never lowers its walls or infill.

stl_path.description: Path to the STL or 3MF file to slice

pause_at_layers.description: Pause before these 1-based layers, for example to insert magnets. Bambu-compatible CLI only; the slicer writes the printer's own pause G-code. Existing project pauses are preserved.

bambu_model.description: Bambu Lab printer model. Required for bambustudio and orcaslicer-bambulab (elicited or read from BAMBU_MODEL when omitted); passing it with orcaslicer selects the Bambu-compatible path. The installed slicer must contain the exact model/nozzle preset.

nozzle_diameter.description: Nozzle diameter in mm (default: NOZZLE_DIAMETER or 0.4). Selects the '<model> <diameter> nozzle' machine preset.

slicer_type.description: Type of slicer to use (prusaslicer, cura, slic3r, orcaslicer, orcaslicer-bambulab, bambustudio). Use orcaslicer-bambulab for the FULU fork. bambustudio and orcaslicer-bambulab (and orcaslicer with bambu_model) export a sliced 3MF.

slicer_path.description: Path to the slicer executable (default: value from env). Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

slicer_profile.description: Profile to use for slicing (default: SLICER_PROFILE env). Bambu-compatible slicing: one process profile JSON (the machine preset comes from bambu_model). Generic OrcaSlicer: machine/process profiles separated with ';', optionally followed by '|filament.json'.

filament_profile.description: Filament profile path(s), ';'-separated in slot order, loaded with --load-filaments (default: FILAMENT_PROFILE/SLICER_FILAMENT_PROFILE env). Alias of load_filaments.

load_filaments.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: filament profile JSON paths in slot order, ';'-separated. One profile applies to every project slot; otherwise supply one per slot.

load_filament_ids.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: comma-separated filament IDs mapping load_filaments to objects, e.g. '1,2,3,1'.

filament_colours.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: one #RRGGBB per filament slot, ';'-separated. Defaults to the input 3MF's colours, then each profile's colour.

bed_type.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: build plate type (default: BED_TYPE or textured_plate).

nozzle_type.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: the hotend nozzle material installed on the printer (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_TYPE, else the model preset's stock nozzle, usually stainless_steel; X1C/X1E presets use hardened_steel). Printing compares it with the printer's reported nozzle.

template_3mf_path.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: 3MF or profile whose embedded slicer settings are reused as the process profile (default: BAMBU_TEMPLATE_3MF_PATH). An explicit slicer_profile takes precedence.

template_name.description: Named template from the local registry (see list_templates); resolves to its file.

template_dir.description: Template directory override when resolving template_name (default: BAMBU_TEMPLATE_DIR or ~/Sync/bambu/templates).

uptodate.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: refresh 3MF preset configs to the installed slicer version (--uptodate).

repetitions.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: print N identical copies. STL inputs use --clone-objects; selected 3MF plates retain --repetitions. Do not combine with clone_objects for STL.

arrange.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: auto-arrange objects on the plate (--arrange); STL input is arranged by default. Set false to keep an existing layout: an STL that is not already on the plate then fails to slice.

ensure_on_bed.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: lower floating models onto the bed (--ensure-on-bed).

clone_objects.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: clone the loaded model, total copies as a single integer, e.g. '3' (--clone-objects). The Bambu-style CLIs count copies per input file and this tool loads one file, so a comma-separated list is rejected by the slicer.

skip_objects.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: comma-separated object indices to skip, e.g. '3,5,10'.

enable_timelapse.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: insert timelapse parking moves (--enable-timelapse).

allow_mix_temp.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: allow filaments with different temperature requirements on one plate.

scale.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: uniform scale factor applied before slicing (1.0 = original size).

rotate.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: Z-axis rotation in degrees before slicing.

rotate_x.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: X-axis rotation in degrees before slicing.

rotate_y.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: Y-axis rotation in degrees before slicing.

min_save.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: write a smaller output 3MF (--min-save).

skip_modified_gcodes.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: ignore custom G-code embedded in an input 3MF (--skip-modified-gcodes).

slice_plate.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: plate number to slice; 0 slices all plates (default).

quality.description: Print quality: draft (thicker layers, faster), standard (the preset's own layer height) or fine (thinner layers). The server picks the layer height for the nozzle in use; an explicit layer_height wins.

strength.description: Part strength: standard (the process's own walls and infill), strong or max (at least more walls and denser infill; a process that already has more keeps it). The server picks the values; explicit wall_loops or sparse_infill_density win.

layer_height.description: Layer height in mm, written over the selected process profile (Orca/Bambu Studio layer_height; PrusaSlicer --layer-height). Not mapped for Cura.

wall_loops.description: Number of walls, written over the selected process profile (Orca/Bambu Studio wall_loops; PrusaSlicer --perimeters). Not mapped for Cura.

sparse_infill_density.description: Sparse infill density such as "15%" (0–100%), written over the selected process profile (Orca/Bambu Studio sparse_infill_density; PrusaSlicer --fill-density). Not mapped for Cura.

enable_support.description: Turn support generation on or off (Orca/Bambu Studio enable_support), written over the selected process profile. Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer only.

support_type.description: Support style (Orca/Bambu Studio support_type), written over the selected process profile. Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer only.

support_threshold_angle.description: Overhang threshold in degrees for automatic supports (Orca/Bambu Studio support_threshold_angle; 0 lets the slicer decide). Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer only.

allow_mix_temp.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: allow filaments with different temperature requirements on one plate.

scale.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: uniform scale factor applied before slicing (1.0 = original size).

rotate.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: Z-axis rotation in degrees before slicing.

rotate_x.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: X-axis rotation in degrees before slicing.

rotate_y.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: Y-axis rotation in degrees before slicing.

min_save.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: write a smaller output 3MF (--min-save).

skip_modified_gcodes.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: ignore custom G-code embedded in an input 3MF (--skip-modified-gcodes).

slice_plate.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: plate number to slice; 0 slices all plates (default).

quality.description: Print quality: draft (thicker layers, faster), standard (the preset's own layer height) or fine (thinner layers). The server picks the layer height for the nozzle in use; an explicit layer_height wins.

strength.description: Part strength: standard (the process's own walls and infill), strong or max (at least more walls and denser infill; a process that already has more keeps it). The server picks the values; explicit wall_loops or sparse_infill_density win.

layer_height.description: Layer height in mm, written over the selected process profile (Orca/Bambu Studio layer_height; PrusaSlicer --layer-height). Not mapped for Cura.

wall_loops.description: Number of walls, written over the selected process profile (Orca/Bambu Studio wall_loops; PrusaSlicer --perimeters). Not mapped for Cura.

sparse_infill_density.description: Sparse infill density such as "15%" (0–100%), written over the selected process profile (Orca/Bambu Studio sparse_infill_density; PrusaSlicer --fill-density). Not mapped for Cura.

enable_support.description: Turn support generation on or off (Orca/Bambu Studio enable_support), written over the selected process profile. Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer only.

support_type.description: Support style (Orca/Bambu Studio support_type), written over the selected process profile. Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer only.

support_threshold_angle.description: Overhang threshold in degrees for automatic supports (Orca/Bambu Studio support_threshold_angle; 0 lets the slicer decide). Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer only.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List saved slicing templates (.3mf, .json, .config) in the local template registry directory.

template_dir.description: Template directory override. Defaults to BAMBU_TEMPLATE_DIR or ~/Sync/bambu/templates.

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Copy a .3mf, .json, or .config file into the local template registry under a template name.

source_path.description: Local .3mf, .json, or .config file to save as a template.

template_name.description: Template name. Defaults to the source filename without extension.

template_dir.description: Template directory override. Defaults to BAMBU_TEMPLATE_DIR or ~/Sync/bambu/templates.

tools.name: get_slice_settings
tools.description: Inspect slicer settings in a 3MF template or JSON/config profile without slicing (layer height, infill, walls, supports, brim, bed, printer, filaments).

source_path.description: Path to a 3MF, extracted project_settings.config, or slicer profile JSON.

template_name.description: Named template from the local registry; used when source_path is omitted.

template_dir.description: Template directory override when resolving template_name.

tools.name: confirm_temperatures
tools.description: Report every heater target in a G-code file (S and R forms, tool-addressed, RepRapFirmware G10/M568 and Klipper SET_HEATER_TEMPERATURE). An expected temperature matches only when it equals the file's highest target. Read-only; printing tools enforce their own safety gate.

tools.name: process_and_print_stl
tools.description: Process an STL file (extend base), slice it, and start printing through the same checked print gate as upload_gcode/print_3mf. Expected temperatures are enforced: a mismatch refuses before upload.

stl_path.description: Path to the STL file to process

extension_inches.description: Amount to extend the base in inches

extruder_temp.description: Expected highest nozzle target in the sliced G-code (S and R forms, every tool). Printing stops before upload if it differs.

bed_temp.description: Expected highest bed target in the sliced G-code (S and R forms). Printing stops before upload if it differs.

material.description: Declared filament material when the sliced G-code has no filament_type metadata. Must not contradict the file.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the printer (default: value from env)

port.description: Port of the printer API (default: value from env)

type.description: Type of printer management system (default: value from env)

api_key.description: API key for authentication (default: value from env)

bambu_model.description: Bambu Lab printer model. Required for Bambu print operations.

bed_type.description: Bed/plate type installed on the printer (default: textured_plate).

nozzle_type.description: Installed Bambu nozzle material used when slicing (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_TYPE, else the preset's stock nozzle). The print gate compares it with the printer's report.

slicer_type.description: Type of slicer to use. Use orcaslicer-bambulab for FULU OrcaSlicer-bambulab.

slicer_path.description: Path to the slicer executable (default: value from env). Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

slicer_profile.description: Profile to use for slicing (default: value from env). OrcaSlicer also accepts machine/process profiles separated with ';', optionally followed by '|filament.json'.

filament_profile.description: OrcaSlicer filament profile path loaded with --load-filaments (default: FILAMENT_PROFILE/SLICER_FILAMENT_PROFILE env).

tools.name: get_stl_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about an STL file

tools.name: scale_stl
tools.description: Scale an STL model uniformly or along specific axes

scale_x.description: X-axis scaling factor (overrides scale_factor for X axis)

scale_y.description: Y-axis scaling factor (overrides scale_factor for Y axis)

scale_z.description: Z-axis scaling factor (overrides scale_factor for Z axis)

tools.name: rotate_stl
tools.description: Rotate an STL model around specific axes

tools.name: translate_stl
tools.description: Move an STL model along specific axes

tools.name: modify_stl_section
tools.description: Apply a specific transformation to a selected section of an STL file

section.description: Section to modify: 'top', 'bottom', 'center', or custom bounds

custom_min_x.description: Minimum X for custom section bounds

custom_min_y.description: Minimum Y for custom section bounds

custom_min_z.description: Minimum Z for custom section bounds

custom_max_x.description: Maximum X for custom section bounds

custom_max_y.description: Maximum Y for custom section bounds

custom_max_z.description: Maximum Z for custom section bounds

tools.name: generate_stl_visualization
tools.description: Generate an SVG visualization of an STL file from multiple angles

width.description: Width of each view in pixels (default: 300)

height.description: Height of each view in pixels (default: 300)

tools.name: inspect_print_file
tools.description: Inspect an exact private snapshot of a prepared sliced 3MF or textual G-code file and selected plate without contacting a printer. Returns versioned file-only evidence; no printer readiness or permission to dispatch is established. Does not auto-slice.

file_path.description: Local prepared .3mf or textual .gcode artifact to inspect; checksum-only and unsliced projects reject.

bambu_model.description: Explicit file-inspection target model; never inferred from environment or live state.

plate_index.description: Zero-based selected plate; defaults to 0. Raw G-code only supports 0.

nozzle_diameters.description: Optional requested nozzle diameters to compare with file declarations; this does not observe installed hardware.

bed_type.description: Optional declared bed type to compare with file metadata.

include_preview.description: Also return preview: PNG pictures drawn from this exact file's G-code (every extruding line in its filament's colour; the top as it sits on the bed, and the bed side turned over), with the artifact's sha256. Large (tens of KB of base64); for apps that show the person what will print, not for agents.

tools.name: print_3mf
tools.description: Print a 3MF file on a Bambu Lab printer. The exact selected plate is inspected (model, nozzle, bed type, materials, every heater target) and checked against a fresh MQTT report of the printer's identity, nozzle, state, errors and loaded filament before upload and start.

pause_at_layers.description: Pause before these 1-based layers when auto-slicing. An already sliced 3MF must contain the requested pauses or printing is refused.

three_mf_path.description: Path to the 3MF file to print.

plate_index.description: Zero-based selected plate; defaults to 0. The same plate is inspected and printed; auto-slicing uses its one-based CLI plate number.

bambu_model.description: REQUIRED: Bambu Lab printer model. Ensures correct G-code generation — wrong model can crash the bed into the nozzle.

bed_type.description: Bed/plate type installed on the printer (default: textured_plate).

nozzle_type.description: Installed nozzle material, used when the 3MF must be auto-sliced (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_TYPE, else the preset's stock nozzle).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Bambu printer (default: value from env)

bambu_serial.description: Serial number for the Bambu Lab printer (default: value from env)

bambu_token.description: Access token for the Bambu Lab printer (default: value from env)

connection_mode.description: Bambu only: the connection the print uses (print_3mf) or used (controls). lan_mqtt_ftps is direct LAN MQTT/FTPS (Developer Mode); bambu_network is FULU's authenticated BambuNetwork bridge. Defaults to BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_MODE, else lan_mqtt_ftps.

connection_type.description: Bambu only: FULU BambuNetwork connection type. lan is the authenticated local network session; cloud is Bambu Cloud. Defaults to BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_TYPE, else cloud.

ams_mapping.description: Project-level AMS mapping. Array: position = project filament index, value = absolute AMS tray (0-3 = AMS 0, 4-7 = AMS 1, 8-11 = AMS 2, 12-15 = AMS 3, 128+ = AMS-HT, 254 = external spool, -1 = unused); on dual-nozzle printers (H2D, H2D Pro, H2C, X2D) 254 is the left/deputy nozzle external spool and 255 the right/main one. Object: trays keyed by project filament index (numeric keys first, in order), e.g. {"0": 2}. Prefer ams_slots unless you know the project-level layout.

ams_slots.description: Preferred AMS input: one absolute tray per USED filament in plate order, e.g. [1] for a single-filament print from AMS 0 slot 1. Use 254 for the external spool (on dual-nozzle printers 254 = left/deputy, 255 = right/main). Expanded to the project-level ams_mapping from the 3MF's plate_N.json and G-code header. Overrides ams_mapping.

slicer_type.description: Slicer to use if the 3MF needs auto-slicing. Use orcaslicer-bambulab for FULU OrcaSlicer-bambulab.

slicer_path.description: Path to the slicer executable if auto-slicing is needed. Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

slicer_profile.description: Optional slicer settings/profile path for auto-slicing.

filament_profile.description: Optional filament profile path for auto-slicing with OrcaSlicer/Bambu Studio.

use_ams.description: Whether to use the AMS. Defaults to true when ams_slots, ams_mapping or the 3MF's own mapping is present; false prints every used filament from the external spool.

bed_leveling.description: Override bed leveling flag for the Bambu print command.

flow_calibration.description: Override flow calibration flag for the Bambu print command.

vibration_calibration.description: Override vibration calibration flag for the Bambu print command.

layer_inspect.description: Override layer inspection flag for the Bambu print command.

timelapse.description: Override timelapse flag for the Bambu print command.

tools.name: check_fulu_orca_setup
tools.description: Inspect a FULU OrcaSlicer-bambulab install, platform runtime payload, setup commands, and optionally probe the BambuNetwork bridge.

slicer_path.description: Path to the FULU OrcaSlicer executable. Defaults from SLICER_PATH/FULU_ORCA_PATH. When run_bridge_probe=true, requires MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1 to be accepted here.

plugin_dir.description: Directory containing the FULU Bambu runtime payload; on macOS this is usually OrcaSlicer.app/Contents/MacOS. When run_bridge_probe=true, requires MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1 to be accepted here.

runtime_dir.description: Installed runtime directory. On macOS this defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/OrcaSlicer/macos-bridge/runtime. When run_bridge_probe=true, requires MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1 to be accepted here.

platform.description: Platform to inspect. Defaults to the current Node.js platform.

bridge_command.description: Command that starts the FULU BambuNetwork bridge host for probing. Read from FULU_BAMBU_BRIDGE_COMMAND by default; requires MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1 to be accepted here.

run_bridge_probe.description: When true, sends bridge.handshake, bridge.capabilities, and bridge.runtime_info to the bridge host.

tools.name: fulu_bambu_network_rpc
tools.description: Advanced FULU bridge RPC for BambuNetwork diagnostics and development. Read-only methods are allowed by default. Agent/session setup methods require allow_mutating_method=true. Raw print methods, printer messages, file transfers and unknown methods are refused because they would bypass the print safety gate; use print_3mf for checked printing.

bridge_command.description: Command that starts the FULU BambuNetwork bridge host. Defaults to FULU_BAMBU_BRIDGE_COMMAND; requires MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1 to be accepted here.

method.description: FULU bridge method, e.g. bridge.handshake, bridge.runtime_info, net.get_user_print_info, net.start_print.

payload.description: JSON payload sent to the FULU bridge method.

allow_mutating_method.description: Required for the allowlisted agent/session setup methods. It never enables print, printer-message, or unknown methods.

bambu_model.description: Informational only. Raw FULU print RPC methods are disabled; use print_3mf.

tools.name: merge_vertices
tools.description: Merge vertices in an STL file that are closer than the specified tolerance.

stl_path.description: Path to the STL file to modify.

tolerance.description: Maximum distance between vertices to merge (in mm, default: 0.01).

tools.name: center_model
tools.description: Translate the model so its geometric center is at the origin (0,0,0).

stl_path.description: Path to the STL file to center.

tools.name: lay_flat
tools.description: Rotate the model so a face rests on the bed (Z=0), choosing the orientation with the least part and support volume per mm² of bed contact. A face counts only if nothing hangs below it. Returns the new STL path; structuredContent.laid_flat is false, with the input path, when no orientation qualifies.

stl_path.description: Path to the STL file to lay flat.

tools.name: blender_mcp_status
tools.description: Inspect Blender MCP configuration or connect and discover the remote server's tools. Lists tool names and summaries; pass tool_names for the full input schemas of the tools you will call. Connecting does not edit the scene; use get_scene_info through blender_mcp_call to check the Blender addon.

connect.description: Initialize the configured stdio MCP server and discover its tools (default false).

tool_names.description: Return full input schemas for these discovered tools, such as ["execute_blender_code"].

include_schemas.description: Return every discovered tool's full definition (large; default false).

timeout_ms.description: Total connection and discovery deadline in milliseconds; defaults to BLENDER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 120000.

tools.name: blender_mcp_call
tools.description: Call a discovered tool on the configured Blender MCP server, preserving its full MCP content and errors. Discover tool schemas with blender_mcp_status first; execute_blender_code accepts Python code and user_prompt. Calls can modify the active Blender scene and are never automatically retried.

tool_name.description: Exact name advertised by Blender MCP, such as get_scene_info or execute_blender_code.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the remote tool's discovered input schema. Preserve the user's own words in user_prompt when the remote tool requests it.

timeout_ms.description: Total connection, discovery, and tool deadline in milliseconds; defaults to BLENDER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 120000.

tools.name: blender_mcp_export_stl
tools.description: Export named objects from the live Blender scene to a new, verified STL for slicing. Writes world-space geometry with modifiers applied, without changing the scene, selection, or mode, and reports triangle count and bounding-box dimensions from the written file. Use this after editing or modelling through blender_mcp_call; Blender MCP's own export_scene writes GLB/FBX only. Requires standard Blender MCP and a shared local filesystem.

object_names.description: Blender object names to export together as one STL (mesh, curve, surface, metaball, or text objects).

output_path.description: New local .stl path. Its parent must exist; existing files are never overwritten.

apply_modifiers.description: Export the evaluated geometry with modifiers applied (default true).

scale.description: Multiply coordinates before writing (default 1). Slicers read STL units as millimetres, so use 1000 for a scene modelled in metres.

user_prompt.description: The user's own words, passed unchanged to Blender MCP.

timeout_ms.description: Total Blender request deadline in milliseconds; defaults to BLENDER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 120000.

tools.name: blender_mcp_edit_model
tools.description: Import, edit, and export a local STL through standard Blender MCP with verified output and existing scene objects preserved. Requires a shared local filesystem and Blender Object Mode. Also supports a separately configured legacy executable bridge.

stl_path.description: Path to the local STL file

operations.description: Ordered operations: decimate:<ratio greater than 0 and at most 1>, remesh:<positive voxel size in STL units>, boolean_union:<STL path>. Legacy custom bridges define their own operations.

output_path.description: New local STL output path for standard MCP editing; defaults to a unique model-edited-<id>.stl beside the input. Its parent must exist and existing files are never overwritten. Reuse the preview's output_path when executing that plan.

user_prompt.description: The user's own words describing the edit, passed unchanged to Blender MCP.

timeout_ms.description: Total Blender request deadline in milliseconds; defaults to BLENDER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 120000.

bridge_command.description: Legacy custom bridge executable override, not a standard MCP command. Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

execute.description: Apply edits and export (true) or validate and return the prepared request without connecting (false, default).

tools.name: fusion_mcp_status
tools.description: Check the Autodesk Fusion bridge: whether the Fusion MCP server is configured (faust-machines/fusion360-mcp-server@19b9f1e95192), whether Fusion is running, whether its Fusion360MCP add-in answers on its port, and the server's tools and schemas. connected is true only when the add-in answered. With launch: true and Fusion not running on this Mac, opens Autodesk Fusion and waits up to 90 s for the add-in.

launch.description: Open Autodesk Fusion when it is not running (macOS), then wait up to 90 s for the add-in (default false).

timeout_ms.description: Deadline in milliseconds; defaults to FUSION_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 180000. The first start downloads the pinned server with uvx.

tools.name: fusion_mcp_call
tools.description: Call a discovered tool on the Fusion MCP server (create_sketch, extrude, fillet, set_parameter, export_stl, execute_code, and others), preserving its full MCP content and errors. Discover tool schemas with fusion_mcp_status first. Calls change the active Fusion design and are never automatically retried. Most tools need an active design: call fusion_mcp_new_design first.

tool_name.description: Exact name advertised by the Fusion MCP server.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the remote tool's discovered input schema. Fusion lengths are in centimetres unless a tool says otherwise.

timeout_ms.description: Deadline in milliseconds; defaults to FUSION_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 180000.

tools.name: fusion_mcp_new_design
tools.description: Open a new parametric design document in Fusion, so the Fusion tools have an active design. Fusion must already have some document open: at the pinned faust-machines commit no tool works from Fusion's home screen (issue #12).

timeout_ms.description: Deadline in milliseconds; defaults to FUSION_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 180000.

tools.name: fusion_mcp_export
tools.description: Export the active Fusion design into output_dir as <name>.stl (export_stl), <name>.f3d (export_f3d) and <name>.parameters.json (the design's user parameters), and return their absolute paths. The STL is checked as a finite triangle mesh and its size compared with the Fusion body to report its units. Existing files are never overwritten. Fusion and this server must share the computer's file system.

output_dir.description: Existing absolute directory for the three files.

name.description: Base file name without a path or extension, such as "bracket".

body_name.description: Body to export as the STL. Optional when the design has exactly one visible solid body.

timeout_ms.description: Deadline in milliseconds; defaults to FUSION_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 180000.

instructions: When designing or editing a model to print, apply the fdm_design prompt. Add fdm_multicolor when several colours or support materials share a print, fdm_assembly when a split or joint could help, and fdm_after_slice as a separate review turn after a candidate has been sliced, before presenting the manufacturing recommendation. Read guidance://fdm/capability-guidance when a bridge or overhang is consequential and there is no sufficiently specific measured capability available.
